divergences.upstreamResult: <Source> clones its children with cloneElement(child, {source: id}), which reaches direct children only and overrides any explicit source prop.
divergences.octaneResult: <Source> publishes its id through a context that <Layer> reads, which reaches any descendant layer and likewise overrides an explicit source prop.
divergences.rationale: Octane's compiler lowers a .tsrx parent's element children to a render function, which cannot be cloned, so the id cannot be injected per child.
divergences.consumerImpact: A <Layer> nested below a wrapper component inside a <Source> inherits that source id, where upstream would have left it unset.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Set an explicit source on layers that must not belong to an enclosing <Source>, and keep such layers outside it.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane gains a way to project props onto a compiled children block.

divergences.upstreamResult: Map, Marker, Popup and GeolocateControl are wrapped in forwardRef and receive their ref through the React ref channel.
divergences.octaneResult: The same components declare `ref` as an ordinary prop; Octane has no forwardRef.
divergences.rationale: Octane follows the React 19 refs-as-props model and does not ship forwardRef.
divergences.consumerImpact: `<Map ref={mapRef} />` continues to work unchanged; only code that wrapped these components in its own forwardRef needs updating.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Pass ref as a normal prop and drop any forwardRef wrapper.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adds a forwardRef compatibility shim.
